name: Disclosure of Student Confidential Information When Safety Is in Jeopardy
description: Information a student shared in confidence must be communicated to parents, the principal or another authority when the health, welfare or safety of the student or others is clearly in jeopardy.
recipient: Parent/guardian, building principal, or other appropriate authority
quote: Information received in confidence from a student s hall be communicated in the manner specified in the accompanying Administrative R egulations to the student's parent/guardian, building principal, or other appropriate authority when the health, welfare, or safety of the student or other persons is clearly in jeopardy.
